# Thomas Zijlstra, CFA — Portfolio & CV

Personal portfolio site and CV for Thomas Zijlstra, CFA.

**Live site:** https://tzijlstra-acn.github.io/CV/
**Web CV:** https://tzijlstra-acn.github.io/CV/cv.html
**Target mode:** https://tzijlstra-acn.github.io/CV/?target=moonshot

## Getting started

```bash
# Install dependencies (required for PDF generation)
npm install

# Generate index.html + cv.html from content.json
npm run build:html

# Check for em dashes in source and generated files
npm run check:copy

# Generate the PDF (requires Playwright)
npm run build:pdf

# Smoke-test all build outputs
npm run verify

# Full chain: build HTML, check copy, build PDF, verify
npm run build:all

# Local dev server (http://localhost:8080)
npm run serve
```

## Build workflow

All HTML is generated from `content.json`:

1. Edit `content.json` (single source of truth for all content)
2. Run `npm run build:html` to regenerate `index.html` and `cv.html`
3. Run `npm run check:copy` to verify no em dashes in source or generated files
4. Run `npm run build:pdf` to regenerate `assets/Thomas_Zijlstra_CV.pdf` from `cv.html`
5. Run `npm run verify` to smoke-test file sizes, PDF signature, and content checks

The PDF generator uses Playwright (Chromium) and writes atomically via a `.tmp` file so the previous PDF is preserved if generation fails.

## Routes

| Route | Description |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Portfolio |
| `cv.html` | Web CV (also used for PDF generation at port 18080) |
| `assets/Thomas_Zijlstra_CV.pdf` | PDF download |
| `index.html?target=moonshot` | Target-specific mode (Business Builder & Ecosystem) |

## Updating content

Edit `content.json` then run:

```bash
npm run build:all
```

The full chain rebuilds HTML, checks for em dashes, regenerates the PDF, and verifies all outputs.

## PDF generation

PDF is generated from `cv.html` via Playwright (Chromium), using an atomic write pattern:

```bash
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run build:pdf
```

If Playwright is unavailable, the script exits with a clear error and the last committed PDF at `assets/Thomas_Zijlstra_CV.pdf` is preserved.

## Target mode (?target=moonshot)

Appending `?target=moonshot` shows a target-specific banner, replaces hero headline and sub text with the moonshot copy, shows the moonshot statement, and reveals additional sections (Enterprise Delivery, Commercialisation Hypothesis, 90-Day Plan, Role Fit) that are hidden in the default view.

## CI

GitHub Actions CI runs on push and pull request to `main`:
- Builds HTML from content.json
- Checks for em dashes (check:copy)
- Generates PDF via Playwright
- Runs smoke checks (verify)
- Uploads build artifacts for review

## Pre-publication checklist

Before making the portfolio live:
- Complete `NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.md` (formal title, LinkedIn, portrait, all open items)
- Complete `PUBLICATION_AUDIT.md` for all 7 linked repositories
- Run `npm run build:all` and confirm all checks pass

## Notes

- No analytics, no external fonts, no tracking
- All public project demonstrations use synthetic, anonymised, mock, or illustrative data
- See `CLAIM_LEDGER.md` for internal claim defence record (not deployed)
